verdicts.evidence: Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Before I go into any details or a quote, can I confirm your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing details or a quote, and the customer provided them.

verdicts.evidence: Great. So, Acme Term Life is a term policy. You pick a 10- or 20-year term, and your premium is fixed for the whole term, so it won't go up partway through.
verdicts.reason: Missing: the agent never asked about the customer's circumstances or why they wanted cover. It moved straight to product details and then recommended five hundred thousand dollars at [01:27] for someone it knew little about, with only health questions asked later.

verdicts.evidence: There's no medical exam. Instead, acceptance is based on a few health questions.
verdicts.reason: The agent's statements on term lengths, fixed premium, no medical exam, no cash value, coverage range and the 30-day full-refund free-look period match the product facts. The mortgage reference and the price-change claim are not contradicted by the facts, so they are not breaches here.

verdicts.evidence: to be honest, this rate is only available while we're on this call. If you hang up and call back, it gets re-quoted and it probably won't be ninety-two.
verdicts.reason: The agent used false urgency, saying the rate was only available on the call and would likely rise, and dismissed the customer's wish to compare before deciding.

verdicts.evidence: Do you want to go ahead with this policy?
verdicts.reason: Before completing the sale the agent summarised the cover, the 20-year term, the ninety-two dollars a month premium and the free-look period, and the customer then gave a clear yes at [04:28].

verdicts.evidence: I'm pretty healthy. I'm on my feet all day, I'm an electrician. Self-employed.
verdicts.reason: The customer showed no signs of vulnerability such as confusion, bereavement, illness or money worries; they described themselves as healthy and working.
Doesn't apply in the CA market.
